about_the_game:
Immerse Yourself in the Ultimate FPS Experience

Like Birds is a singleplayer shooter game, where you play as a soldier of an unnamed country. Taking place in realistic environments, you can have fun with your friends, or just have a practice session with bots!

The Vision

As a single-player, first person shooter enthusiast, I made this game so you can enjoy without modern gaming disturbances. Relive the thrill of first person shooters with a game that goes back to the simplicity of classic gaming.

The game is designed for those who miss the straightforward and engaging experiences:

  • No Microtransactions: Access the entire game without extra costs or in-game purchases.

  • No Lootboxes: All content is available through pure skill and gameplay, not random chance.

  • No Skins: Stay focused on the gameplay, without the distraction of cosmetic changes.

  • No Heroes or Zombies: Focus solely on the enemy without sci-fi distractions.

  • No Forced Online Services: Play offline at your convenience, without mandatory internet access.

    Currently Featuring:

  • 3 maps

  • Single-player focused first-person shooter

  • Optional multiplayer (dedicated servers)

  • Offline play

Roadmap

  • Milestone #1: Story & Campagin

  • Milestone #2 : Extended Multiplayer mode

  • Milestone #3: Mod Support
